verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships an official CLI (nitropy) and an Entra ID provisioning guide, so bulk operations, such as provisioning or managing many devices or credentials at once, is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence documents any bulk or batch capability. The CLI's existence and the provisioning guide title do not show multi-item operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
